We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template as result of task make_5_lvl1-template_search-1 to the molecule. The previous step gave mapped_rxn and template_id 29646. So we need to apply that template to the given molecule to get precursors.

We have the template ID 29646. Need to get template SMARTS via get_template, then apply_template with molecule SMILES.

Molecule SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need to call get_template first to retrieve SMARTS (maybe not needed for apply_template, which expects template ID). apply_template expects template_id string, maybe like "template_29646"? The ID given earlier is 29646 (numeric). The tool expects string identifier, maybe "29646". We'll try.

First, apply_template.
